spans.text: ...Temporary command post, Berlin.
Utterly exhausted, the Commander flops down on the sofa right after entering the room.
Since you've safely returned to the command post, we'll go get some rest ourselves.
Sure, your work for the day is over too.
Hurry, 45! If we don't leave soon, the queues are going to be super long!
Coming. See you tomorrow, Commander.
The transmission ends, and the Commander lifts a hand up to their forehead.
How was Miss Ange?
Well enough. At the very least, she looked like she could still easily snap my neck.
Speaking of which, about Machlian—
Perosa stands in the doorway with a cup of strong tea in hand.
What happened?
She's awake, Commander.
Also, I think you'll need this.
The Commander accepts the tea, which is at just the right temperature. Its thick aroma fills the nose and lifts the spirits.
Get Dandelion. We'll begin the interrogation.
She's compiling our information on Bohnsdorf.
Then we'll start without her.
Inside the room, Machlian has already woken up and is sitting on a chair while glaring coldly at the Commander.
The Commander drags a chair over and sits opposite her.
Your name is Machlian, is that correct?
Yes.
What about you? Are you really called Robin?
No comment, but you can keep calling me Robin if you like.
...I knew it.
Still, you did save me.
The Commander looks up from the information on the tablet and carefully studies Machlian's appearance.
She's still a little groggy and confused, having just woken up from being knocked out.
She looks practically identical to the picture of Morridow, but her temperament couldn't be any more different.
Is Morridow just that good at disguising herself, or is she really somebody else?
When did you first join Paradeus?
I was never part of Paradeus. I'm just an ordinary person.
From what I know, there is a girl from Paradeus who looks just like you.
You might have heard her name before—Morridow.
What is your relationship with her?
Or are you her, perhaps?
I have only one name—Machlian. That's the only thing people call me.
So you refuse to disclose the nature of your relationship with her?
I don't care about her affairs and I don't want to hear about her. I want nothing to do with her for the rest of my life.
Machlian's eyes fill with fear and pain at the mention of Morridow's name.
Then let's talk about you. When we found you, you were in Bohnsdorf.
Bohnsdorf was a refugee shelter that was built a few years ago. What were you doing there?
...Treating ELID patients.
Why?
There's no why to it. Since I have the ability to do so, I ought to use it to treat refugees in need.
To my knowledge, there is no existing medical cure for ELID.
The most common therapy nowadays involves strengthening the patient's antibodies to gradually defeat the illness.
But I saw you pray over a refugee and perform a certain ritual, and then the refugee got better, just like that.
What did you do? Was it some kind of medicine?
Yes...
Where did your medicine come from?
Who supplied you with the medicine?
Machlian looks like she wants to say something, but her lips quiver for a long time without uttering a word.
Are you afraid of something?
Machlian goes quiet, avoiding the question.
If all you want from me is treatment...
Then you can just bring the patients to me, and I will save them.
But if you kidnapped me because you're after the exact treatment method, then you have wasted your time.
Because I'm the only one who can administer it.
We haven't known each other for a long time, but I can sense that you're different from those who profit off anti-ELID products. Profit is not your goal.
I am not saying this to trick you or win your trust. I simply wish for us to meet each other halfway.
If you release me, I am willing to help you.
There is a creak as Dandelion pushes the door open.
Commander, I've finished compiling the information on Bohnsdorf.
The moment she sees Dandelion, Machlian's calm features begin to distort...
Paradeus... You...
You're from Paradeus...
What?
Machlian's eyes fill with tears as she glares at the Commander with a look of anger and despair. Disbelief and betrayal are written all over her face.
Here you are again!
What are you going to do to me this time?!
You're going to strap me onto a slab and torture me forever, aren't you?!
We aren't going to do that! Machlian, please, calm down...
Machlian laughs derisively as she stares blankly.
I won't let you have your way.
Neither him, nor YOU.
Nobody will—
Commander, her virtual cognition image is disintegrating!
She's coming! She's coming!
I can hear her footsteps!
Dandelion, subdue her!
On it.
A second later, Machlian knocks over the table as she slumps limply to the ground.
What does it mean when a virtual cognition image disintegrates?
Simply put, it's like a Doll's neural cloud meltdown.
A virtual cognition image? Is that the Paradeus' equivalent of a neural cloud? Why have I never heard that term before?
Because I just made it up on the spot.
I have already verified the presence of a virtual cognition image in Machlian, which is to say she is 100% a Nyto.
I should also point out that now is when her defenses are the most lax, so I recommend hacking her directly.
Why didn't you tell me earlier? Will it cause her harm?
You never asked.
And her current lack of resistance will actually minimize the damage we inflict.
Then get started right away. I want answers!
Understood.
